हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
A privileged man, Abhay Kumar, is falsely imprisoned for a hit-and-run accident orchestrated by his own family.
After years of brutal injustice, he rebuilds his life from nothing and returns as a powerful entrepreneur.
Truth, betrayal, and redemption collide as Abhay exposes the real culprit and reclaims his dignity and identity.
